name: belej-consulting/lettie
description: Lettie - incoming and outgoing mail management

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the unit, integration and functional PHPUnit suites (integration and functional recreate the TEST_DB_NAME database).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Unit tests only: no database needed.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Repositories and services against the test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:functional: HTTP requests through the Kernel against the test database.
scripts-descriptions.demo:seed: Recreates the lettie_demo database with realistic data (small: ~10 months, for screenshots). Options after --: --seed=N --skip-checks.
scripts-descriptions.demo:seed:medium: Demo database with 2 years of activity (~3,500 mails): pagination, exports, filters.
scripts-descriptions.demo:seed:large: Demo database with ~100,000 mails (bulk history): performance timings.
